gen-dafont-junegull-gf-liter: Liter reads modern, with no stroke contrast at all and wide mouths on its round forms. And Junegull, with its pinched curves and cast-iron stature, belongs up big and brief.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Junegull is retro and friendly, its curves pinched nearly shut. Noto Sans Adlam sits beneath it with curve endings held well apart, so the eye moves from tight, uniform strokes to open, full lowercase.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-armenia: Junegull is retro and friendly, built from one width of stroke with its curves pinched nearly shut. Noto Sans Armenian loosens things up, with wide, inviting openings on its round letters.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Junegull brings retro friendliness, with each curve pinched nearly shut and arches on r, n and m matching their stems. Noto Sans Avestan leaves its curve tips open, with a pronounced x-height.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Big open counters in every small letter give the body a clean, modern feel. Noto Sans Bamum should feel light over a full page of text, while Junegull's pinched, closed letters stay up top.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-bassa-v: Noto Sans Bassa Vah has a dominant midsection and an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers. But Junegull's constant, stencil-cut weight would feel lost if the heading were made small.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-batak: Junegull's lowercase stands like cast iron capitals, pinched at every curve. Noto Sans Batak brings a towering x-height and a generous e, so the unmodulated heading meets an approachable body.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-elymaic: Noto Sans Elymaic reads clean and open, with apertures wide throughout. Junegull, retro and friendly with its pinched curves, does its best work large and brief, where those closed shapes can be seen.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-limbu: Noto Sans Limbu has small letters with real height and curves that gape open. But Junegull is the one for loud, retro display, its strokes free of hairlines and shadows.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-mende-k: Junegull draws pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin. Where Junegull is best at friendly, retro display, Noto Sans Mende Kikakui is best at letting daylight through every curve.
